stories.title: USA WNT Full Roster Analysis — 10 Days to Group Oklahoma Qualifier (TIER 1 — FOLLOW UP)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
USA Softball is 10 days from Oklahoma City.

The WNT roster for the WBSC World Cup Group Stage: 2 Olympians. 7 World Games gold medalists. 4 Sooners.

Mexico, Netherlands, China, Brazil, New Zealand all standing in the way of a 2027 World Cup berth. 🇺🇸🥎

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
4 Sooners on the Team USA World Cup Group Stage roster:

Alyssa Brito. Jayda Coleman. Tiare Jennings. Kelly Maxwell.

10 days until Devon Park, OKC. Gasso coaches the team. Gasso also coaches OU. That's a wild September. 🥎 #TeamUSA
